abstract: BACKGROUND: Nongestational pure ovarian choriocarcinoma is a rare malignancy with only 29 cases described to date. CASE: We describe a case associated with mature cystic teratoma of the contralateral ovary. Details of all 30 cases including clinical features, associations, surgicopathological findings, operative procedures, postoperative chemotherapy, and outcome are summarized. CONCLUSION: This rare malignancy responds well to surgery and postoperative chemotherapy including the methotrexate-based regimes.
abstract_ja: 背景：非妊娠性純粋卵巣絨毛癌は稀な悪性腫瘍で、これまでに29例しか報告されていない。症例：対側卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴う症例を報告する。これまでの30例について、臨床的特徴、合併症、手術病理所見、手術術式、術後化学療法、転帰を含めてまとめた。結論：この稀な悪性腫瘍は手術と術後化学療法（メトトレキサートを含むレジメン）に良好に反応する。
